notes: No source found reports Beaver Valley Hospital's federal Provider Relief Fund total ($22.3M) or compares it to its 2019 patient revenue. Press coverage of the hospital is about its Medicaid nursing-home (UPL) program, not COVID relief; those sources give 44 nursing homes/licenses vs the lead's 40 enrollments. One Utah legislative table shows a separate $6.28M state COVID-19 payment to the hospital (FY2021). KFF gives the rural/CAH pattern only. A Health Affairs study on PRF targeting (doi 10.1377/hlthaff.2022.01411) returned 403 and wasn't recorded. A FOX 13 page listing UPL totals through Q2 2026 had no page date and no COVID content. Query 5's tool call ran several sub-searches internally; logged as one query. Nothing found dated after 2026-06-30.
